title: Library Survey - Student Satisfaction
description: Pie charts showing student opinions about university library services
prompt:
The charts below show the results of a survey conducted by a university library to find out the opinions of full-time and part-time students about its service.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

title: Living Alone and Small Families
description: Discussion essay about changing family structures in developed countries
prompt:
In developed countries, many people are living alone or as a small family unit. Why do you think this is happening? How does it affect society?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Mobile Phone Market Share
description: Line graph showing market share of three mobile phone manufacturers
prompt:
The line graph below illustrates the proportion of mobile phone sales by three manufacturers (Motorola, Nokia and Sony Ericsson) between 1994 and 2004.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

title: Hosting Big Sporting Events
description: Discussion essay about the value of hosting major sporting events
prompt:
Some people think that it is a waste of money for countries to host big sporting events like the world cup, and that the money would be better spent on other things. However, others think that hosting large sporting events has a clear, positive impact on a country.

Discuss both these views and give your opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Wind Energy Production
description: Bar chart showing wind energy generation in four countries
prompt:
The bar chart shows the amount of energy generated by wind in four countries from 1985 to 2000.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

title: Work vs Life Without Work
description: Opinion essay about peoples preference for work
prompt:
When asked to choose between a life without work and working most of time, people would always choose not to work. Do you agree or disagree with this statement?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Success: Hard Work vs Other Factors

Some people think that success in life comes from hard work and determination, while others think that there are more important factors such as money and appearance.

Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Air Travel and Environment
description: Opinion essay about discouraging air travel for environmental reasons
prompt:
Airplane uses more fuel and causes more pollution than car do. In such a case non-essential air travel should be discouraged in order to make the environment better rather than limiting the car use.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Credit Cards: Advantages vs Disadvantages
description: Discussion essay about easy access to credit cards
prompt:

Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Young Population Trends

Write at least 250 words.

title: Young People and Happiness
description: Problem-solution essay about youth unhappiness despite prosperity
prompt:
In some countries young people are not only richer, but also safer and healthier than ever before. However, they are often less happy. What do you think are the reasons for this and what can be done to help?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
